column1: # mega-assert check registry — one id per line.
# The runner cross-checks this against the check files in both directions: an id
# here with no implementation fails, and an implementation not listed here fails.
# Neither a deleted check nor an unregistered one can pass quietly.
# The floor is 0 while the registry is empty. U2 raises it as the mega-doctor
# checks migrate, so a run that registers nothing stops being a clean run.
